canonical_project: AOK Thueringen / Lotto Thueringen Rechenzentrum on Gothaer Strasse
notes: Datacenter-Insider reported a 2018 smoke incident at the Suhl data center of AOK Thueringen and Lotto Thueringen on Gothaer Strasse; operations reportedly continued. Older local reporting notes Suhl had a state data-center outpost that the state planned to replace with two other state data centers; facility treated as operational enterprise DC with no public MW.
